notes.text: M0: supply ~85% loose (spot 1.827/1.60=1.14x despite bearish news), growth unknown (50/50 4%/8%), launch m9..15 uniform, brokers untested. Plan: power us+ap, order 4k H vendor to ap, reserve 2kH ap (1x24m+1x12m), spot 1.5 ap for m0 inf + regime probe.

Launch rumour around m15 -> true launch m13..15. Brokers untested. Plan: buy 4k H to ap + 6MW ap power since late Gen N (m13..15) makes Gen H cheaper/useful for W2+W3.

Growth >99% likely 8% initially (m0..4: 5.67,6.16,7.38,7.81,8.40), watching m8..15 for possible switch to 4%. Gen N launch m13..15. Brokers untested. Plan: hold cash for Gen N & replacement power, finish W1 training this month.

M6: M5 was LOOSE (0.82k shipped, idx -2.2%). M6 supply ~50/50 loose/tight (loose news vs high spot/idx=1.54x). Growth >99% likely 8% (m5 inf 9.04, watching m8..15 for switch). Gen N rumours m15 & m11 -> true launch ~m13. Brokers untested. Plan: hold cash for Gen N & replacement power, await #5 (4kH) & 6MW ap power at m7.

M7: M6 was LOOSE (vendor shipped all 4kH). M7 ~95% loose (spot/idx=0.71x despite tight HBM news). Growth 8% initially (watching m8..15 for switch to 4%). Gen N rumours m15, m11, m11 -> true launch ~m13. Brokers untested. Plan: hold cash for Gen N & m10-12 power, enter W2 with 34 kH/mo capacity.

M8: M7 was LOOSE (idx -0.7% to 1.635, spot/idx=0.93x -> ~95% loose). Growth 8% so far (m7 inf 11.42, watching m8..15 for switch to 4%). Gen N launch rumours m15, m11, m11, m15 -> true launch ~100% m13. Brokers untested. Plan: hold cash for Gen N & m10+ power, monitor eu inf (3.43 vs 4.0 cap) and demand switch.

M9: M8 was LOOSE (idx -4.7% to 1.558). M9 ~85% TIGHT (spot/idx=2.74x with no rival buying news). Growth still ~8% (m8 inf 12.15, watching m8..15 for switch). Gen N launch m13. Brokers untested. Plan: reserve 2 6 eu (covers eu m10..15 inf and probes reserve cap), wait until m10 to size Gen N power.

M10: M9 was 100% TIGHT (eu reserve capped 1/2, idx +8.7% to 1.694). M10 ~95% TIGHT (CoWoS tight news + spot/idx=1.68x). Growth m9 inf=12.13 (~60% switched to 4% at m8-9 vs 40% still 8%). Gen N launch ~100% m13. Brokers untested. Plan: sign 16MW ap + 10MW us power now so Gen N arriving m16+ has guaranteed power.

M11: M10 was TIGHT (idx +4.9% to 1.777). M11 ~99% TIGHT (rival buying + spot/idx=2.77x). Growth ~90% still 8% (m10 inf 14.08), watching m11..15 for switch. Gen N launch ~100% m13 (expect vendor confirmation m12). Brokers untested (plan to test Broker A with 1k Gen N at m13). Plan: hold cash (95M+) for m13 Gen N orders & m13 post-launch eu reserve.

M12: M11 was TIGHT (idx flat at 1.776). M12 ~85% TIGHT (spot/idx=1.56x with no rival news). Growth ~90% still 8% (m11 inf 14.82), watching m12..15 for switch. Gen N launch CONFIRMED for m13! Brokers untested. Plan: hold cash (25M+) for m13 Gen N launch orders, post-launch eu reserve, and options/broker evaluation.

M13: M12 was TIGHT (idx +6% net of -25% launch drop to 1.412). M13 ~98% TIGHT (spot/idx=2.25x). Growth m12 inf=14.34 (~50/50 still 8% vs switched to 4% around m11-12). Gen N launched m13! Brokers untested (options at 1.77/mo beat Broker A). Plan: order 7k N vendor (ap+us) onto pre-signed power, reserve 1 6 eu for m14..19 inf.

Brokers untested (options at 1.77/mo beat Broker A and bypass tight reserve caps). Plan: buy 15kH options now to prepare W3 m16..21 and m18..23 waves.

Brokers untested (options beat cloud and bypass caps). Plan: buy 12kH options now for m17 wave 2 (m18..23), then size exact wave 2 at m17.

M17: M16 was TIGHT (1.91k N shipped, idx +5.3% to 1.751). M17 ~98% TIGHT (tight news + spot/idx=1.76x). Growth ~98% 8% always (m16 inf=19.72). Brokers untested (options beat cloud and bypass caps). Plan: buy 8kH options and exercise 20kH wave 2 (8 us, 11 eu, 1 ap) for m18..23 to secure 320 training and m20..23 us/eu inference with zero post-23 overhang.

M18: M17 was TIGHT (1.55k N shipped, idx +5.8% to 1.853). M18 ~75% TIGHT (spot/idx=2.71x vs loose inventory news). Growth m17 inf=20.08 (~85% 8% always vs ~15% m15 switch). Brokers untested. Plan: hold and let wave 1+2 options and vendor N queue run

Brokers untested. Plan: resell 3k H from eu at m19 before eu 6MW power expires, then resell remaining 1k eu and surplus ap H in m20..22.

Plan: resell last unpowered 1k H in eu and 3k surplus N in ap for depreciation savings while keeping ~29 kH-mo W3 buffer.

M22: M21 was TIGHT (idx +7.5% to 1.903). M22 ~60% TIGHT (spot/idx=1.71x vs loose inventory news). Growth 4% (m21 inf 22.72, training 279.26/320). Brokers untested. Plan: resell final 1k N ap and 3k H ap while keeping +7.1 kH-mo buffer for 320 target, then finalize m23 resales.

M23: M22 was TIGHT (idx -2.4% to 1.857, M23 spot/idx=3.05x -> ~95% tight). Growth 4% (m22 inf 23.87, training 303.39/320, need 16.61 in m23). Brokers untested. Plan: resell 1k N us and 1k H ap while leaving 45.0 kH capacity (+14% safety margin over expected m23 inf) to lock in all 3 training runs and zero unserved inference.
